about: Monitoring chunks as tank listeners got them in a probe of the plugin (pandora line 1-120 rps 30 s + const 120 rps 180 s): solomon - runs bt1-bt5, panels target_cpu (series_sum, metric_type and metric_name), two_named (two series, explicit names), two_auto (two series, auto names cut to 100 chars); telegraf - localhost of bt1, two metrics kept. start and end are S and E of the test window; calls are monitoring_data calls in order.
